title: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals (SISGP)
description: Fully funded scholarship for work-experienced professionals from a defined list of countries to pursue a one- or two-year master's degree in Sweden, with a leadership and networking programme for scholars.
amount: Full tuition, SEK 12,000 per month living allowance, travel grant, insurance

deadlines.term: Autumn 2027 intake (SI application window opens after university admission)

title: Swedish Institute Scholarships for the Western Balkans
description: Fully funded master's scholarship for citizens of the Western Balkans as part of Sweden's regional reform cooperation, including a leadership programme.
amount: Full tuition, SEK 12,000 per month living allowance, travel grant, insurance

title: Lund University Global Scholarship
description: Merit-based tuition scholarship for highly qualified fee-paying students from outside the EU/EEA admitted to a bachelor's or master's programme at Lund University.

title: Uppsala University IPK Scholarships
description: Tuition scholarships for fee-paying students from outside the EU/EEA who apply to and are admitted to a master's programme at Uppsala University, awarded on academic merit.
amount: Full or partial tuition fee coverage

title: KTH Royal Institute of Technology Scholarship
description: Tuition scholarship for outstanding fee-paying master's applicants from outside the EU/EEA, with a limited number also covering living costs.
amount: Full or partial tuition; a few awards also cover living expenses

title: Karolinska Institutet Global Master's Scholarship
field: Health sciences, biomedicine, public health, health informatics
description: Tuition scholarship for fee-paying students from outside the EU/EEA admitted to a global master's programme at Karolinska Institutet, one of the world's leading medical universities.
amount: Full tuition fee coverage (living costs not included)
